purpose: Search the existing Ubuntu package catalog for zero-cost local OCR and PDF rasterization capabilities after PATH probing found none installed.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
pkgs=["tesseract-ocr","poppler-utils"]
out={"schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_APT_CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY_V1","packages":[]}
for pkg in pkgs:
    p=subprocess.run(["apt-cache","policy",pkg],text=True,capture_output=True)
    s=subprocess.run(["apt-cache","show",pkg],text=True,capture_output=True)
    out["packages"].append({
      "name":pkg,
      "policy_returncode":p.returncode,
      "policy":p.stdout[:4000],
      "metadata_returncode":s.returncode,
      "metadata":s.stdout[:8000]
    })
path=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-CAPABILITY-DISCOVERY-APT-OCR-001__PACKAGES.json")
path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("APT_OCR_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE")
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
